panorama:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: continuous side-scrolling game BACKGROUND MASTER PANORAMA for BitDog: Zoomies, Satoshi Park.
Input image 1: character STYLE reference only. Match the polished warm hand-painted 2D animation / illustrated anime game quality of this golden retriever model sheet. Do NOT draw the dog or reproduce the model sheet.
Generate a VERY WIDE single uninterrupted 3:1 panorama, ideally 3072x1024. One cohesive landscape, not multiple panels. It will be cut into adjacent lossless tiles, so the entire master must be a single continuous camera view with one fixed horizon, light direction, scale and perspective.
Scene: a sunny, welcoming suburban park suitable for a golden retriever's adventure. Soft blue-green sky, small warm cream clouds, distant rolling sage-green hills, layered leafy deciduous trees with honey-colored sunlit edges, occasional creamy white picket fences behind the meadow, tiny white daisies, warm spring grass. A gentle winding footpath can remain far in the midground; no large diagonal foreground road. Left third: a quieter sunny lawn at the neighborhood edge. Middle third: leafy grove and rolling meadow. Right third: an open golden-lit meadow with distant low hills. These are connected naturally, not divided.
Composition: strictly side-on horizontal side-scroller environment. Sky occupies upper 40%, distant hills and tree canopy fill middle; lower 20% is a quiet unobstructed meadow continuing uniformly across the entire width, suitable to be covered by foreground gameplay terrain. Do not paint collision objects, jumps, cliffs, giant loops, or a playable platform into this background. Trees should vary naturally without obvious repetitions.
Style: beautiful detailed painted game environment, soft cel-shaded forms with subtle brush texture, coherent perspective and sunlight, richer and more finished than geometric placeholder shapes, cheerful without looking babyish. Moderate contrast so the golden dog with orange bandana remains readable in front.
Constraints: NO characters, NO dogs, NO humans, NO coins, NO text, NO labels, NO borders, NO grid, NO panorama panel divisions, NO UI. Full-bleed opaque landscape. Maintain visual continuity across the full width.

NO people, NO dog, NO hands, NO coin, NO stars, NO text or UI. We animate the actor and coin separately. Do not add a new biome, mountains towering over the scene, city skyscrapers, fantasy structures, or an unrelated landscape. Full-bleed opaque image.
props:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent environmental prop atlas for BitDog: Zoomies.
Reference image 1: exact Satoshi Park painted environment and sunlight. Match its illustrated cel/painterly game art.
Generate six isolated game props on genuinely transparent alpha background, neatly spaced in a 3-column by 2-row grid. Each prop must stay well inside its own equal-sized cell with generous empty margins. No labels, no grid lines, no cast shadow outside the objects, no background, no people, no dogs.
Top row left to right:
1. One sunlit deciduous park tree with natural green/gold foliage, brown trunk, whole crown and root base visible. Side-on game view.
2. One cozy small golden wooden doghouse with terracotta sloping roof, dark round-topped entrance and a small orange Bitcoin emblem above the entrance; front three-quarter view.
3. One small square wooden crate with diagonal reinforcing planks, same warm wood style.
Bottom row left to right:
4. One short section of cream-white wooden picket fence with exactly three upright pickets and two cross-rails, straight-on view, no perspective narrowing.
5. One thick round gold Bitcoin coin, almost straight-on, clean readable embossed Bitcoin symbol, warm rim highlights, no glow.
6. One blank wooden park direction sign on a post, arrow-shaped board pointing right, pale wood face left blank so text is drawn in game.
All props should have crisp readable silhouettes at small game sizes, beautiful hand-painted texture matching the supplied panorama, coherent warm sunlight from upper left, soft cel shadows. Isolated assets only, no floor planes. Keep each item separate.
